features.name: Failure-First Execution Reporting Protocol
features.description: Enforces an ordering requirement where any failed action must be reported first, followed by partial/incomplete actions, and completed actions only after prior stages have been accounted for.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Contains fields 'Report failure first.', 'If any action failed, state every failed action before reporting partial, incomplete, or completed work.', 'Next report every partial or incomplete action.', and 'Only after all failed, partial, and incomplete actions have been reported, report completed actions.'

features.name: Granular Evidence-Backed Action Verification
features.description: Requires every action claimed complete to be recorded individually and backed by direct granular evidence, including the exact source, locator, and observed content from earlier execution turns.

evidence.reference_symbol_or_heading: $.current_state.procedure.step_records.4.execution_return.Step_4['For every action claimed complete, include granular evidence that shows completion.']
evidence.mechanic_summary: Maps each completed action to completion_evidence items containing 'source', 'locator', and 'observed_content' referencing prior turn schemas.

features.name: Partitioned Ordered Action Status Classification
features.description: Maintains isolated, ordered arrays for failed, incomplete, and completed actions to prevent ambiguity between partial progress and full completion.

evidence.reference_symbol_or_heading: $.current_state.procedure.step_records.4.execution_return.Step_4['Keep failed, partial/incomplete, and completed work in separate ordered fields.']
evidence.mechanic_summary: Defines an object with separate ordered lists: 'failed_actions', 'not_completed_actions', and 'completed_actions'.

features.name: Step Record File Persistence
features.description: Records and verifies persistence of the step record to a designated JSON store path on the filesystem.

evidence.reference_symbol_or_heading: $.current_state.procedure.step_records.4.execution_return.Step_4['Print this step's record to persistent storage.']
evidence.mechanic_summary: Records the persistence path 'ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/runs/run_20260330_9f8e7d6c/store/store.json -> Step_4 record persisted' and supervisor confirms target and locator.

features.name: Verbatim User Request Preservation
features.description: Preserves the original user request unchanged across execution steps within the execution return payload.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Maintains the unedited prompt string and supervisor evaluates that 'Verbatim user request preserved without alteration.'

features.name: Supervisory Gate Recursive Granular Mirror Evaluation
features.description: Enforces supervisor evaluation immediately after execution step completion by creating an exact key-for-key and entry-by-entry mirror of the execution return schema, replacing terminal values with an evaluation status ('PASS'/'FAIL') and supervisor comment.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Recursively mirrors every returned key and array entry under Step_4 with 'evaluation' ('PASS') and explanatory 'comment' for each terminal node.

features.name: Supervisory Gate Granular Failure Isolation
features.description: Collects separate failure records for any failed granular or step-level evaluation without combining independent failures.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Contains an explicit instruction: 'Create one list entry for every FAIL in granular_evaluation or step_level_evaluation. Do not combine independent failures.', holding empty array value when no failures exist.

features.name: Supervisory Gate Transition Control
features.description: Gates advancement to the next procedure execution step based on the supervisory gate result evaluating to PASS.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Defines 'transition_key': 'supervisory_gate.gate_result' with 'transition_value': 'PASS' along with step instruction 'The next execution step is permitted only when gate_result is PASS.'
